import pandas as pd
from sklearn.feature_selection import f_oneway
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from itertools import combinations


def task_func(data_file_path: str):
    df = pd.read_csv(data_file_path)

    # Convert all columns to numeric, handling commas as decimal separators.
    numeric_df = df.apply(
        lambda col: pd.to_numeric(
            col.astype(str).str.replace(",", ".", regex=False),
            errors="coerce",
        )
    )

    means = numeric_df.mean()
    std_devs = numeric_df.std()

    axes = []
    for column in numeric_df.columns:
        fig, ax = plt.subplots()
        ax.hist(numeric_df[column].dropna(), bins=10, edgecolor="black")
        ax.set_title(f"Histogram of {column}")
        ax.set_xlabel(column)
        ax.set_ylabel("Frequency")
        axes.append(ax)

    anova_results = pd.DataFrame(columns=["Column 1", "Column 2", "F-value", "P-value"])
    if numeric_df.shape[1] >= 2:
        rows = []
        for col1, col2 in combinations(numeric_df.columns, 2):
            values_1 = numeric_df[col1].dropna()
            values_2 = numeric_df[col2].dropna()
            if len(values_1) > 0 and len(values_2) > 0:
                f_stat, p_value = f_oneway(values_1, values_2)
            else:
                f_stat, p_value = float("nan"), float("nan")
            rows.append(
                {
                    "Column 1": col1,
                    "Column 2": col2,
                    "F-value": f_stat,
                    "P-value": p_value,
                }
            )
        anova_results = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    return means, std_devs, axes, anova_results
